title: BLS powers: run gate, round-stopped giants (expected work 115.061094141149849)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 auxiliary-powers G1 target at n=2^20, one cold run of the supplied run-gated, round-stopped paired class-walk Cheon algorithm recovers s with probability at least 0.39 over the uniform challenge and fresh algorithm coins, conditional on H1' (prefix coverage, proof.md s44; H1 is its last case), H2-H5 in source-proof.md and H7 in proof.md s37 (H4 as per-class pair fraction 998/1000 and leaf share 193/200, checked before group work). The run first draws one fresh 64-bit coin: with probability 1-K/2^64 it stops there at charged cost 64 and fails (a closed gate is a failure, never a success); K=7278735950792122682 is the least integer with (K/2^64) lo_run>=0.39, lo_run=0.9883900497... being the lower bound of an opened run's success at K_T=9/2 (proof.md s2). An opened run walks its giants in at most 2^16 rounds and stops at the first round that yields a verified s. W(n) is the expected total work of this one run over that probability space, every trial, failure and closed gate included: W(n)<=2^115.061094141149849 G1-reference units (C=2000) for 2^20<=n<r, namely (64+(K/2^64) E_run)/2000 with E_run=219651626593153277666464787652681294692 instructions bounding an opened run's mean work (proof.md s44). This bounds the mean, not one run: every run does at most 2^117.850134357989963 units, and an opened run can cost more than W(n). It reads only A_1,A_(2^20). Opened-run preprocessing<2^115.4224 units, included; peak memory<2^123.0005 bytes; no advice. All failures, transfers, verification and output are charged. Nodes use the disclosed flat unsigned 64-bit address model. This is an analytic conditional bound, not a production execution. Q=13/50 and K_T are chosen values, not minima. H1', H2-H5 and H7 are not closed.

experiments.purpose: Default: exact ledger, arithmetic and listing audits, character check. Mode all adds planner, curve recovery, transport and the round-order census. Finite evidence only.
